Name: Crop Walker
Author: MindMeltMax
TagLine: Allows players to walk through crops without slowing down and more
Description:
Wrote this really quickly for a playthrough and decided to upload it.
This "Fixes" some things that have bugged me for a long time while playing.

Firstly it removes the slowdown while walking through crops.
Secondly it removes the slowdown while walking through grass (in caves aswell).
And as an added bonus it makes trellis crops passable (very basic version, recommended use with [Walk Through Trellis](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1958)  or [Passable Crops](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15223))

**How to install :**
1. Install [Smapi](http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI)
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder

[[Source Code]](https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/CropWalker)
